collection.title: KGM Tivoli 2024 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The KGM Tivoli 2024 Onwards version uses a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" wiper blade on the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
